أحلولي (form XII)
# أَحْلَوْلِي (ʔaḥlawlī) /ʔaħ.law.liː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْلَوْلَى (iḥlawlā)
# أَحْلَوْلِيَ (ʔaḥlawliya) /ʔaħ.law.li.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْلَوْلَى (iḥlawlā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
